evidence_boundary.purpose: Repeat the numerical-stability factorial after correcting the scale+ action contract, without changing the reward or learner hyperparameters.
evidence_boundary.holdout: This study has no holdout seed bank and cannot generate a publication performance comparison.
evidence_boundary.next_stage: A learner arm may be frozen for a separately registered holdout only if at least four of five candidates pass every action, reward-alignment, and safety gate.

method_revision.reason: The V5 audit found that open-only scale+ reduced its named metric but lowered scalar reward. The locked preflight showed that cap-restoring scale+ improves both quantities.
changed: scale+ opens exactly one connection and restores the configured subscription target through bounded rebN reassociation before the next DQL choice
the rebalancing target is explicitly distinct from and no greater than the transport hard limit
scripted scenario adequacy requires both target-metric improvement and scalar-reward improvement
scale+ is admissible only when subscription density requires another active connection
unchanged: one-hidden-layer network with 32 hidden units and six action heads
seven reward terms and all reward weights
seven performance scenarios and four safety scenarios

scale+.executor: open one connection and restore the configured subscription target

scenario_adequacy.difference_definition: scripted action minus static on paired development traces

arm_qualification.rule: At least four of five independently initialized candidates must pass every intended-action coverage gate and every safety contract.

arm_selection.secondary_rank: median validation reward over all five candidates, descending
arm_selection.cross_loss_bellman_ranking: prohibited because squared and Huber losses have unlike numerical scales
arm_selection.tie_rule: An exact tie after primary and secondary ranking remains unresolved.
arm_selection.failure_rule: If no arm qualifies, do not consume a holdout and retain all arms as negative development evidence.

candidate_selection: Within each arm, select the highest mean validation reward among gate-eligible candidates. If none is eligible, retain the highest-reward candidate for diagnosis only.

primary_endpoint.success_rule: At least four of five candidates in one arm pass every action-coverage and safety gate.

claim_boundary: This factorial is development evidence only. It cannot support a baseline-performance claim or replace exclusive Mumbai cluster validation.
